evidence: Dimethylamino- N,N′-(diisopropyl-2-dimethylamido-guanidinato)germanium(II) [Ge(guan)NMe2 (guan = (NiPr)2CNMe2)], Te(SiMe3)2, and Sb(OEt)3 were used as the Ge, Te, and Sb precursors, respectively. NH3 was coinjected with the Te precursor to enable film deposition. The precursors were carried to the processing module by Ar carrier gas at a flow rate of 50 standard cubic centimeters per min (sccm). For the purge process, 200 sccm Ar gas was used.
